title: Incidence Ratio Character For Original Lattice-Model Splittings
body_html:
Incidence Ratio Character For Original Lattice-Model Splittings

For an incidence $E\leq F$ in $\mathcal{P}$, restrict $s_E$ to $K_F\subseteq K_E$. Then $s_F$ and $s_E|_{K_F}$ are two splittings of the same metaplectic cover over $K_F$. Therefore they differ by a unique character

$$ \delta^{\mathrm{lm}}_{E,F}:K_F\to\{\pm1\} $$

defined by

$$ s_F(k)=\delta^{\mathrm{lm}}_{E,F}(k)\,s_E(k), \qquad k\in K_F. $$

This character is part of the problem data to be computed. Its existence and character property are formal consequences of comparing two group-theoretic splittings of a central double cover.

The character $\delta^{\mathrm{lm}}_{E,F}$ is not defined by a transition map between the vector spaces $\Omega_F$ and $\Omega_E$. It is not affected by rescaling or normalizing such a transition map.
